answer: At each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and registers a Semaphore identity in a zero-knowledge tree, committing to an RLN rate-limit polynomial. Each authorized message carries a nullifier and a proof that its evaluation is consistent; a duplicate nullifier yields two distinct shares of the same Shamir-encoded secret, reconstructing the private key and enabling instantaneous collateral slashing. Thus whisper, zenith, or relic identities cannot multiply influence without risking their bond.
